Definition: properly, an environment, i.e. circumstance or turn of affairs
BiblicalUsage: Rehoboam will not listen to the people, for the turn of affairs is from God, that His word to Jeroboam might be performed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the turn of affairs belongs to God: Rehoboam's stubbornness and Jeroboam's rise are both in His hand, and the kingdom divides because the LORD said it would.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
